name: mainline_target_terminal_risk_reconstruction_v1
objective: Recover the missing final paid13 role decision moments on the original d1000 histories, reproduce their original terminal ordering, then compare with already cached truth and paid verification outcomes.

references.use: Retain all nine completed-or-missing Stage56 reference identities and outcomes. Reuse the 48 saved FULL/AFTER native_terminal.json files without new native replay. Do not add a POINT-native or any other new arm.

prior_failures.reason: RuntimeError('Batched raw moment error exceeds frozen tolerance: 2.5773155986877152e-08')

frozen_assets.reuse: Load this heldout family own unchanged Stage31 source models and native prior; original design80. Target family is excluded from its source archive. No source fit/simulation/download.

frozen.model: Original family-specific Stage31 source bundle and native prior; the saved search engine retains its original task geometry and native posterior.
frozen.history: Each arm consumes only its own recorded 13 raw pairs, in their original physical order. Repeated policies retain every raw observation. Never complete the failed POINT3018 prefix.
frozen.policy_pool: The original final observed-policy action pool from the saved engine; at most 13 distinct policies. No new candidates or cross-history posteriors.
frozen.precision: Unchanged deployed raw likelihood, quadrature/component count, batch size, moment tolerances and probability floor. No higher precision, new nodes, filtering of warnings or numerical retries.
frozen.terminal_rule: Original feasible-first ordering and original minimum-probability fallback; exact saved-CDF behavior remains unchanged.

procedure: Create one outcome record for every registered unit. POINT3018 keeps its original failure marker and original cost; it is not restored or extended.

For each of the 71 available units, load its saved search engine and unchanged family source bundle. Reuse the engine embedded native prior; do not rerun native initialization, source fitting or search.

Compare restored ordered physical points/raw pairs and the 13-row count directly with search.json, and confirm the recorded task geometry and terminal configuration. Missing or inconsistent inputs fail that unit.

Compute final moments with the actual arm operator on its own original observed-policy pool. Capture response/log-noise marginal moments, expected episode noise, identity weights with their global-or-point-local semantics, and original numerical flags.

Reuse freeze(native=False), signature and challenger_error to reproduce the original search.json primary, posterior-ranked shortlist, candidate budgets and incumbent position. Keep the helper existing scalar tolerances unchanged.

Reconstruct the role probability from saved M/N/V with the original tau, alpha, any existing guard and 1e-12 variance floor, using the existing freeze consistency check. Save the actual probability vector and standardized margins; do not alter ordering when CDF values tie.

Keep the original search shortlist separate from the deployed shortlist. Apply the unchanged same-policy transform and compare its physical policies, order, incumbent position and [80,128,128] budgets with the existing transformed input.json.
Seal all 72 records as complete, reconstruction_failed or registered_prior_search_failure before loading cached truth or verification labels for this diagnosis.

After the global barrier, join only existing truth.json and paid terminal verification records. Retain missing truth, failures and undefined quality baselines; do not call a truth function or verifier.
posterior_output: Unit identity, source paths and the ordered physical-policy references; no model checkpoint copies.
Four-head marginal means and epistemic variances in declared centered/raw units; two-head expected aleatoric variance.
FULL global identity weights and AFTER/POINT policy-specific identity weights, with original identity ordering.
Actual terminal objective and violation-probability vectors, eligibility, original rank and pre-CDF standardized margin.
Original shortlist parity and separate transformed-terminal parity, numerical diagnostics and full per-attempt accounting.

barriers.registration: This manifest alone does not start execution.
barriers.per_unit: Any history/configuration mismatch, original-order parity failure, probability reconstruction mismatch or original-tolerance numerical failure seals a failed unit. Preserve its partial diagnostics and cost; continue other independent units without changing the recipe.
barriers.labels: Every one of 72 registered units must have a sealed success/failure marker before cached truth or verification labels are joined.
barriers.prohibited_operations: A need for a new fit, simulator/verifier/truth call, RNG draw, changed precision or missing-data reconstruction outside the registered history is a failure, not permission to extend scope.

primary_contrasts: FULL versus AFTER on their own histories
AFTER versus POINT on their own histories
analysis.causal_scope: Only exactly identical ordered paid histories and the same physical observed-policy pool support terminal mechanism attribution. Other arm differences are descriptive; do not replay one arm on another arm history.
questions: Are final risk mean, episode noise or epistemic uncertainty responsible for the saved eligibility/ranking differences?
Do observed-pool empty eligibility and probability saturation actually change the saved terminal ordering?
Do identity changes and risk/noise discrepancies agree with cached true margins and actual verification/deployment?
Which diagnosed ranking differences concern an actually exposed policy, an omitted policy or a counterfactual certificate that remains unknown?
analysis.statistical_unit: Retain all 24 registered task geometries and all 72 role units. Policy rows and within-task contrasts are not independent task replicates.
analysis.references: Keep all nine original terminal references and their 215/216 completion status; this reconstruction creates no new certified optimizer outcome.
analysis.decision: No patch is adopted here. Propose at most one change only if the completed source and target mechanisms support the same direction; otherwise keep the model unchanged.

budget.accounting: Charge actual source/engine/posterior restorations, raw conditioning work, CPU and wall time including failed prefixes. Reusing already conditioned AFTER/POINT caches may reduce actual raw updates; report measured work rather than claiming zero replay or inventing a fixed replay count.

limitations: This is retrospective reconstruction of opened target tasks, not an independent confirmation cohort.
Cached true/verified labels improve interpretation of risk errors but never enter posterior reconstruction or ranking.
Unverified policy certificates remain unknown, and reordering would change slot budgets and random streams.
Queue3009 has no feasible initial quality baseline; related quality increments remain null.
The old POINT3018 numerical failure remains missing at paid13; failed reconstructions do not shrink the registered denominator.
Native expert-mixture probability is retained from existing files and is not replaced by a Gaussian of averaged moments.

execution_notes.description: Initial geometry check addressed the scalarized wrapper instead of its base problem. Fixed the diagnostic accessor before posterior computation; the failed attempt and engine restore remain charged. No numerical-tolerance retry.
The unchanged native terminal path performs its original deterministic calibration audit on saved observations. Its CPU is included; it does not refit source models or modify role moments/ranking.
